kjv: that it may be displayed because of the truth (KJV 60:4)
mine: that they may flee to it from the bow
note: mippene qoshet: qoshet is either Aramaic "truth" or a byform of qeshet "bow" (LXX "from the bow"); with lehitnoses (rally/flee to the banner) the military image fits the bow.
mehoqeqi is the ruler's staff or scepter (Gen 49:10, Num 21:18), matching "Ephraim is my helmet".
